title: OTC PRN (as-needed) dosing defaults
description: OTC label defaults for explicit confirmation. Pediatric weight bands reproduce the cited children's charts without mg/kg calculation. The shared lookup refuses below minAgeMonths or at/above maxAgeMonths (exclusive), before checking weight. Bands use inclusive lower weight bounds; between bands, the lower band applies. Ingredients without a weight-band chart omit pediatric data.

citation.source: U.S. FDA OTC Drug Facts labels (public).
citation.note: Every value is a public OTC Drug Facts label figure; each entry additionally carries its own per-entry `source`. Pre-fill suggestions only, never applied silently.
